shows.title: Trade / The Human Voice
shows.description: A double bill of two intimate Irish one-acts about hidden desires and unspoken loneliness. In Mark O'Halloran's Trade , a young man meets his middle-aged client in the inner city of Dublin. This time, the client arrives with blood on his shirt… He tries to explain what happened and secrets are slowly revealed in this thrilling play about yearning and loneliness. In Darren Murphy's contemporary adaptation of Jean Cocteau's La Voix humaine , a woman in Belfast is pulled between stressful demands at work and a phone call from her lover who's leaving her for good. Told in the form of a one-sided conversation, she must negotiate the collision between her private and public worlds.

shows.title: The Gap Year
shows.description: Three lifelong friends set off on a belated "gap year" across all 32 counties of Ireland to reclaim their independence and rediscover life's small joys. Newly widowed Kate, childminder-in-chief Roisin, and divorcée Oonagh decide that enough is enough: life is too short to be held back by dusty old expectations. They hop in a campervan, explore a new side of Ireland, and discover a new side to themselves. Buckle up for a journey of castles, coffee, and plenty of craic! The Gap Year follows a life-changing adventure, the magic of new beginnings, and the sustaining power of female friendship.

shows.title: Taylor Mac: Holiday Sauce
shows.description: Ibsen Award Winner and Pulitzer Prize finalist Taylor Mac is back at Soho after 15 years taking on the holidays to celebrate the season in all of its dysfunction.

shows.title: Mother Courage And Her Children
shows.description: Mother Courage drags her cart through a wasteland stripped bare by greed and conflict - a profiteer, a survivor, and a mother. She’s learnt to make a living from war, and she’ll sell whatever’s left of humanity to keep herself and her children alive.
